displayDescription: A silhouette raises a glowing idea at twilight, and strings of light link the buildings on a ridge into one connected system.
styleRenderer: SVG (layers, mask-based light reveal, filled silhouettes)
Paper.js 0.12.18 (boolean-united compound contours and window cutouts, built once from fixed rest geometry)
motionEngine: GSAP (single paused seekable timeline owns every animated property)
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene. The bulb glow is approximated with flat translucent bloom discs, and the spreading light is a masked solid value step. Neither is physical lighting.
Motion was not used. GSAP alone covers the needed actions, so each property has one owner.
No preview recipe is listed in STYLE.json, so the refresh demonstrates the BACKGROUND_REVIEW scene-dependent palette and construction lessons.
The background review covers only sampled source seconds. No source subject, lettering or composition is copied.
The palette tokens are scene choices for this preview, not approved brand colours.
